rationale: GPU audio compute kernels only: the GpuCompute WaveNet layer shader regains its original gated activation expression (restoring exact equality with the kernel before the samples-per-workgroup rewrite), and the shared-I/O provider WaveNet program keeps its history in column rings and runs a block in one pass. Outputs are bit-identical to the prior kernels, verified old-vs-new at 0 ULP. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves; no UI paint path changes.
